_metadata.description: AI generation of brand text facets via the local LLM chain (Ollama-first, OpenRouter fallback) and brand imagery (logo/favicon generation, prompt-based editing, background removal, derived icon variants) via the image-tools scenario through a narrow ImageBackend client seam. Degrades gracefully when text providers or image-tools are absent.

requirements.title: Generate brand text via the Ollama-first provider chain
requirements.description: Palette, typography, and voice are generated through the text LLM chain, trying Ollama first and falling back to OpenRouter, and merged onto the brand (partial-merge, version bump). Image generation is NOT part of this chain.

validation.notes: Covered by api/internal/generation/service_test.go (GenerateElements paths) + providers_test.go (chain ordering).

requirements.title: Generate brand imagery via image-tools (logo / favicon)
requirements.description: Logo/favicon images are generated by building a brand-aware prompt and calling image-tools text_to_image through the ImageBackend seam (submit → wait once → download blob), then stored as a brand asset under a unique filename and promoted to the canonical asset on first use or when set_canonical is requested.

validation.notes: Covered by api/internal/generation/service_test.go (GenerateImage via FakeImageBackend) + handler tests; live readiness via image-tools models doctor/explain.

requirements.title: Edit an existing brand image by instruction via image-tools
requirements.description: An existing brand image is loaded and edited via image-tools edit_instruct with a natural-language instruction, storing the result as a new brand asset (never overwriting the source by default).

validation.notes: Covered by api/internal/generation/service_test.go (EditImage) + handler test (EditBrandImage, missing-source NotFound).

requirements.title: Remove a brand image background via image-tools
requirements.description: A source brand image is cut out via image-tools background_removal, storing the transparent result as a logo-transparent asset for use as the isolated mark in icon derivation.

requirements.title: Derive a deterministic platform icon set
requirements.description: A deterministic icon set (transparent favicons 16/32/196; opaque solid-background apple-touch 180 and maskable 192/512) is derived from a source asset using image-tools' deterministic resize plus a same-size alpha flatten onto the brand color. Idempotent: re-deriving yields byte-identical assets.

validation.notes: Covered by api/internal/generation/service_test.go (DeriveIcons full set + favicon-only selection).

requirements.title: Generation degrades gracefully when a backend is unreachable
requirements.description: When no text provider is reachable, text generation returns UNAVAILABLE. When image-tools is unreachable or a model/backend is not installed (or a BYOK key is missing), image RPCs return actionable typed errors (UNAVAILABLE / FAILED_PRECONDITION) and GetImageBackendStatus reports per-operation readiness — other domains remain usable, nothing crashes.

validation.notes: Covered by error-mapping tests (ErrProvidersUnavailable, ErrImageBackendNotReady→FailedPrecondition) in service_test.go + connect_handler_test.go.
